name: Black Bear
traits: Tyler Kamstra's DMs Guild player conversion for 2014 fifth edition, using the v2 printed traits.
Medium awakened Beast, usually neutral. Strength +2 and Constitution +2. Walk 40 ft. and climb 30 ft.
Unarmed bites and claws deal 1d8 piercing or slashing, respectively. Unarmored AC 12 + Dexterity modifier. Smell-based Wisdom (Perception) checks have advantage.
Cannot wield weapons, use shields, or operate items that need hands. Speaks, reads, and writes Common.
Brown Bear uses this same player trait block by the cross-reference on p. 225.

name: Boar
traits: Tyler Kamstra's DMs Guild player conversion for 2014 fifth edition, using the v2 printed traits.
Medium awakened Beast, usually neutral. Strength +1. Walk 40 ft. Unarmored AC 11 + Dexterity modifier. An unarmed tusk hit deals 1d6 slashing.

Charge adds 1d6 damage once per turn when you move at least 15 ft. toward the creature and hit it with a Strength-based melee weapon attack. The bonus is 2d6 at level 5, 3d6 at level 11, and 4d6 at level 17.
Relentless can leave you at 1 HP when reduced to 0 HP without being instantly killed. Recharges on a long rest.
Cannot wield weapons, use shields, or operate items that need hands. Speaks, reads, and writes Common. Giant Boar uses these same player traits by the cross-reference on p. 234.

name: Camel
traits: Tyler Kamstra's DMs Guild player conversion for 2014 fifth edition, using the v2 printed traits.
Medium awakened Beast, usually neutral. Strength +1 and Constitution +1. Walk 50 ft. An unarmed bite deals 1d4 slashing.
Cannot wield weapons, use shields, or operate items that need hands. Speaks, reads, and writes Common.

name: Cat
traits: Tyler Kamstra's DMs Guild player conversion for 2014 fifth edition, using the v2 printed traits.
Small awakened Beast, usually neutral. Dexterity +2. Walk 40 ft. and climb 30 ft.
An unarmed bite deals 1d4 slashing. Strength or Dexterity applies to attack and damage rolls. The bite qualifies as a finesse weapon for features such as Sneak Attack.
Cannot wield weapons, use shields, or operate items that need hands. Speaks, reads, and writes Common.

name: Constrictor Snake
traits: Tyler Kamstra's DMs Guild player conversion for 2014 fifth edition, using the v2 printed traits.
Medium awakened Beast, usually neutral. Strength +1 and Dexterity +1. Walk 30 ft. and blindsight 10 ft.

Proficient unarmed bite or constrict deals 1d8 slashing or bludgeoning, respectively. A successful constrict hit with the Attack action lets you spend a bonus action to initiate a grapple against that target, despite having no hands.
Cannot wear armor, use weapons or shields, or operate items that need hands. Speaks, reads, and writes Common.
Giant Constrictor Snake uses these same player traits by the cross-reference on p. 234.
